svg.title: The Playfair Cipher
svg.desc: The key PLAYFAIR fills a 5 by 5 square. HELLO is cut into the pairs HE, LX, LO; each pair moves by the same-row, rectangle or same-column rule, giving KGYVRV.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', 'DejaVu Serif', serif
